item.question: What are the benefits of using a three-level Multilevel Mixed Model in Monte Carlo simulation studies compared to a two-level model?
item.answer: The three-level Multilevel Mixed Model (MLMM) offers all the advantages of a two-level model while providing additional insights into generalizability through random slope variances. This is not possible with the two-level model, which cannot identify analogous random slopes models.
